# Packages the default-workspace-template installs into every workspace.
#
# Seed list, hand-derived from dwt's scripts/setup_system.sh apt installs and
# the env.d units' Chromium/Fortress system libraries (what `playwright
# install-deps chromium` pulls on trixie). Names are the explicitly-installed
# top level only: dependencies are NOT resolved here, and the mirror's
# read-through covers anything a list misses, so gaps degrade to slower first
# fetches, never to missing packages. Verify and extend this list against a
# freshly created workspace (see README).
#
# Format: one package name per line; `#` starts a comment; blank lines ignored.

# --- setup_system.sh system toolchain ---
bash
build-essential

curl

jq
less

openssh-server
procps
restic
ripgrep
rsync
sqlite3
supervisor
tini
tmux
unison
util-linux
wget
xmlstarlet
xxd
